mutations.because: If every replayed mutation reports as verified, the tool certifies any claim a lane makes - including the false ones it exists to catch. A green check on an unverified claim is worse than no check.
A manifest recording a survived mutation is a lane shipping a test it knows does not catch. Accepting one would let the record say the opposite of what happened.

Without the baseline a suite that is already red verifies every claim made against it: the replay would issue a green check on a branch whose tests never passed. That is the false green the verifier exists to prevent.

A command that never launched has no exit code to read, so the placeholder 1 would be counted as a catch and a typo in the command would certify the claim. The gate must report the launch failure instead.
